content.comment_body: Can someone assist me? How can I store counter values permanently in a programmable logic controller so that counting continues from the previous session unless I manually reset the counter? Split from memory bit topic on [product_name].
Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. To achieve persistent counting, you need to activate the retentivity setting for the counter within its properties.

analysis.insight_summary: The user wants to preserve counter values in a programmable logic controller so counting resumes unchanged after restarts, unless a reset is performed. Another participant notes that this is possible by enabling retentivity in the product's configuration, emphasizing the importance of understanding and using data retention for persistent values in [company_name] PLC devices.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the programmable logic controller to maintain counter values through power loss or resets, allowing the count to continue until explicitly reset. This requires non-volatile storage of the values.
